title: SC clubs Red Fort blast cases for one trial in Delhi; India to host 2029 Champions Trophy; ASEAN and China miss South China Sea code deal

morning.greeting: Good morning, and happy International Students' Day!
morning.line: It's Tuesday. Expect a foggy, chilly start, so leave a few minutes early and wear a warm layer.
morning.thought: A student is not a bucket to be filled but a lamp to be lit. Bring your own spark to class today: one question, one idea, one effort.

day.name: International Students' Day
day.about: 17 November is observed worldwide as International Students' Day, honouring students' right to education and their role in society. In India, 17 November is also remembered as the death anniversary of Lala Lajpat Rai, the 'Punjab Kesari', who died in 1928 after being injured in a lathi-charge during a protest against the Simon Commission.

headlines.title: Supreme Court allows the Red Fort blast cases from J&K and Haryana to be tried together in Delhi.
headlines.summary: The Supreme Court allowed criminal cases filed in Jammu and Kashmir and Haryana to be moved to a special NIA court at Patiala House, New Delhi. Three FIRs from Delhi, J&K and Haryana will now be heard in one joint trial. The Court said the cases share the same accused, witnesses and evidence, so one trial avoids conflicting judgments and reduces security risks. The blast near the Red Fort Metro Station on 10 November 2025 killed 12 people.
headlines.gk: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) was set up under the NIA Act, 2008, after the 26/11 Mumbai attacks. An FIR (First Information Report) is the first written record of a crime made by the police.

headlines.title: Navy chief says India is closely watching China's growing presence in the Indian Ocean.
headlines.summary: Navy Chief Admiral Krishna Swaminathan spoke at the National Security Summit in New Delhi. He said the Navy is closely monitoring China's growing presence in the Indian Ocean Region. He called the Indian Ocean a 'global commons' where every country has freedom of navigation. He added that the Navy is ready for today's conflicts while preparing for future ones in new areas of warfare.
headlines.gk: Navy Day is observed in India on 4 December. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the armed forces.

headlines.title: ASEAN and China fail to finish a code of conduct for the South China Sea.
headlines.summary: At the ASEAN summit in Manila, ASEAN and China could not complete a code of conduct for the disputed South China Sea. About 80% of the draft has been tentatively agreed, but they still differ on whether it should be legally binding. Talks have gone on for more than 20 years. The Philippines, this year's chair, hopes Singapore can finish the work when it chairs ASEAN in 2027.
headlines.gk: ASEAN was founded in 1967 through the Bangkok Declaration and has its secretariat in Jakarta, Indonesia. In 2016 an international tribunal ruled that China's sweeping claims in the South China Sea had no legal basis; China rejects the ruling.

headlines.title: Pope Leo XIV speaks out against the killing of Indigenous leaders and the destruction of the Amazon.
headlines.summary: On 15 November, Pope Leo XIV addressed a mostly Indigenous audience in Pucallpa, in Peru's Amazon region. He said many Indigenous leaders have been killed for defending their lands. He asked people to oppose deforestation and pollution from illegal mining and oil spills. Peru lost about 2 lakh hectares of natural forest in 2025, according to Global Nature Watch. The Pope is on a 12-day tour of Latin America that also included Uruguay and Argentina.
headlines.gk: Vatican City, inside Rome, is the world's smallest country. The Amazon rainforest spreads across nine countries, with Brazil holding the largest share.

headlines.title: Indonesia's President apologises to Singapore and Malaysia for haze from wildfires.
headlines.summary: At the ASEAN summit, Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto said sorry to Singapore and Malaysia for the smoky haze caused by months of forest fires in his country. The fires, mainly on Sumatra, Borneo and Papua, took nearly four months to control, and 71,000 firefighters were deployed. Sixteen firefighters died. Indonesia has cancelled 17 company permits and police are investigating 104 companies.
headlines.gk: Haze is smoky air pollution from burning forests and peatlands. The ASEAN Agreement on Transboundary Haze Pollution was signed in 2002.

headlines.title: India will host the 2029 Champions Trophy and co-host the 2031 ODI World Cup.
headlines.summary: The ICC Board fixed the windows for major men's cricket events up to 2035. India will host the 2029 Champions Trophy from 9 to 28 October. India and Bangladesh will co-host the 2031 ODI World Cup from 9 October to 23 November. Australia and New Zealand will host the 2028 T20 World Cup, while England, Scotland and Ireland will host the 2030 T20 World Cup.
headlines.gk: The ICC (International Cricket Council) has its headquarters in Dubai. India won the ODI World Cup in 1983 and 2011.

headlines.place: Ministry of Commerce & Industry · New Delhi
headlines.title: India's total exports rise 16.66% to USD 568.84 billion in April-October 2026-27.
headlines.summary: India's total exports (goods plus services) reached USD 568.84 billion in April-October FY27, up from USD 487.59 billion a year earlier. Merchandise exports were USD 309.06 billion and services exports USD 259.78 billion. In October 2026 alone, total exports were estimated at USD 89.99 billion, 29.90% higher than in October 2025. Non-petroleum, non-gems & jewellery exports rose to USD 240.73 billion.
headlines.gk: Trade data is released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Total exports = merchandise (goods) + services.
headlines.exam: Remember: 16.66% growth, USD 568.84 bn total (Apr-Oct FY27); merchandise USD 309.06 bn, services USD 259.78 bn; October USD 89.99 bn (+29.90%).

headlines.title: RBI gives Paytm Payments Services in-principle approval to issue prepaid payment instruments.
headlines.summary: Paytm Payments Services Ltd (PPSL), a wholly owned subsidiary of One 97 Communications, received in-principle authorisation from the RBI under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007. It can issue and operate Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPIs) such as digital wallets. PPSL must submit a system audit, including a cybersecurity audit, within 6 months or the approval lapses. In the same period, RBI fined One MobiKwik Systems Rs 9 lakh for not following PPI rules.
headlines.gk: PPIs are payment instruments loaded with money in advance, like e-wallets and gift cards. The RBI was set up in 1935 and has its headquarters in Mumbai.
headlines.exam: Governing law: Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007. Audit deadline: 6 months. MobiKwik penalty: Rs 9 lakh.

headlines.title: Centre notifies commodity trading as a financial service under the IFSCA Act, 2019.
headlines.summary: The Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, notified commodity trading contracts as financial products and commodity trading as a financial service. The change took effect on its publication in the Official Gazette on 13 November 2026. The aim is to make GIFT City IFSC a global commodity trading hub and attract business now routed through Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong and Switzerland. Earlier, the IFSCA Board had approved a Global Commodity Trading Platform (GCTP) at GIFT City.
headlines.gk: IFSCA (International Financial Services Centres Authority) was set up on 27 April 2020 and is headquartered in GIFT City, Gandhinagar. Its Chairperson is K. Rajaraman.
headlines.exam: Remember: IFSCA Act, 2019; notified 13 Nov 2026; GCTP; IFSCA HQ GIFT City, Gandhinagar; Chairperson K. Rajaraman.

headlines.title: WHO Global TB Report 2026: India cut TB deaths by 38% between 2015 and 2025.
headlines.summary: The WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026 says India's TB deaths fell 38% from 2015 to 2025, more than the global fall of 35%. India's treatment success rate for drug-susceptible TB is 94%. India still accounts for 25% of the estimated 10.6 million TB cases worldwide in 2025. Global TB deaths were 1.13 million.
headlines.gk: WHO (World Health Organization) was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland. World TB Day is observed on 24 March.
headlines.exam: Key numbers: India 38% vs global 35% fall in TB deaths; 94% treatment success; India = 25% of 10.6 million global cases.

headlines.title: President Murmu presents Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 awards; Navi Mumbai tops the Super Swachh League.
headlines.summary: President Droupadi Murmu presented the 10th Swachh Survekshan Awards on 11 November 2026, organised by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. Sixty national awards were given. In the Super Swachh League, Navi Mumbai came first, Surat second and Vijayawada third. A new 'Swachh Shehar Jodi' category paired 70 mentor cities with 191 mentee cities.
headlines.gk: Swachh Survekshan is the annual cleanliness survey of Indian cities under the Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban), launched on 2 October 2014.
headlines.exam: Super Swachh League top 3: Navi Mumbai, Surat, Vijayawada. 10th edition; Swachh Shehar Jodi = 70 mentors + 191 mentees. Ministry: MoHUA.

headlines.title: 12th India-Sri Lanka joint military exercise 'Mitra Shakti' under way till 26 November.
headlines.summary: The 12th edition of exercise Mitra Shakti began on 13 November 2026 at the Army Training School, Maduru Oya, Sri Lanka, and will run till 26 November. Each side has 170 personnel. The Indian contingent, mainly from the Rajputana Rifles along with IAF personnel, is led by Lt Col Anirudh Mangotra.
headlines.gk: Other India-Sri Lanka exercises include SLINEX (navy). Sri Lanka's capital is Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte, and Colombo is its commercial capital.
headlines.exam: Mitra Shakti = India-Sri Lanka army exercise; 12th edition; Maduru Oya; 13-26 Nov 2026; 170 personnel each; Rajputana Rifles.

ai.title: China plans to teach AI to every schoolchild by 2030.
ai.summary: China wants all its schoolchildren to learn about artificial intelligence by 2030. Younger pupils will start with basic ideas, while older students will use AI tools in projects and learn to think critically about them. Shanghai already asks every grade to spend at least 30 hours a year on AI skills. Researchers also warn about depending too much on AI: one study of about 27,000 teenagers linked AI use to better homework grades but lower exam results.
ai.gk: China has nearly 200 million children in primary and secondary schools. India's NEP 2020 also asks schools to teach coding and computational thinking.

quiz.q: By which year does China aim to make AI literacy universal among schoolchildren?

ai.title: India and nine other countries sign a declaration to keep AI supply chains safe.
ai.summary: On 15 November, India, the USA and eight other nations signed the 'San Francisco Declaration' on the security of AI supply chains. It comes under the US-led Pax Silica initiative, which aims to secure the supply of silicon chips and key minerals needed for AI. The signatories are the US, Australia, India, Israel, Japan, South Korea, Qatar, Singapore, the UAE and the UK.
ai.gk: A supply chain is the full path a product takes, from raw materials to the final user. Silicon is the main material used to make computer chips (semiconductors).

quiz.q: How many countries in all signed the San Francisco Declaration on AI supply chains?
quiz.explain: India, the US and eight other nations = 10 countries.

ai.title: Education Minister launches an AI-powered Vidya Samiksha Kendra with a 'Samiksha AI Bot' for Kendriya Vidyalayas.
ai.summary: On 12 November, Education Minister Pralhad Joshi inaugurated the AI-integrated Vidya Samiksha Kendra (VSK) of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan in New Delhi. Its Samiksha AI Bot studies school data, flags gaps and suggests actions so officials can step in early. Live dashboards track attendance, results, infrastructure and admissions. He also launched the KVS-Samvaad parent app and a KVS Alumni Connect Portal, all built in-house by KVS.
ai.gk: Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) runs central government schools and has its headquarters in New Delhi. Vidya Samiksha Kendras are data centres that monitor school education.
ai.exam: Remember: Samiksha AI Bot + AI-integrated VSK of KVS, launched 12 Nov 2026 by Pralhad Joshi; KVS-Samvaad app for parents.

quiz.q: What is the name of the AI tool in the new KVS Vidya Samiksha Kendra?
quiz.explain: The VSK uses the Samiksha AI Bot to analyse school data.

ai.title: Bihar approves a Rs 190.32 crore AI Mission to certify 7,000 students in advanced AI.
ai.summary: The Bihar Cabinet approved the Bihar AI Mission on 10 November 2026. Over five years, 7,000 undergraduate and postgraduate students from both science and non-science streams will get a five-month advanced AI certification, about 1,400 each year. The partner is the Singapore-based Global Finance and Technology Network (GFTN). The plan also sets up the Aryabhata Technology Observatory, an AI and quantum sandbox to support over 100 startups.
ai.gk: Aryabhata was an ancient Indian mathematician-astronomer; India's first satellite (1975) was named after him. Bihar's capital is Patna.
ai.exam: Figures to note: Rs 190.32 crore, 7,000 students over 5 years, partner GFTN (Singapore), Aryabhata Technology Observatory.

quiz.q: Which sandbox will the Bihar AI Mission set up for startups?
quiz.explain: It is called the Aryabhata Technology Observatory.
